title: PetSafe ScoopFree Crystal Pro Legacy Self-Cleaning Litter Box, Uncovered
say: Customers find the litter box easy to use, with amazing setup instructions, and appreciate that it makes maintenance easier. However, the functionality and value for money receive mixed reviews - while some say it works well and is worth the investment, others report it doesn't work at all and find it not worth the cost. The odor control and ease of cleaning also get mixed feedback, with some saying it keeps smells down while others disagree, and while some find it easy to clean, others find it hard to maintain. Moreover, durability is a concern as the box breaks after 6 months, and customers report issues with poop getting stuck in the rake.
